headline: ED 🧔 SHEERAN's Mr Nice Guy 🍬 Persona COOKS 🍳 His TOUR 🚫
text:
MUSIC'S 🥁 ultimate MR NICE GUY 🕴️ ED 🧔 SHEERAN just got absolutely COOKED 🍳 by his own DIPLOMATIC 🍽️ vibe when every remaining SUPPORT 🎤 act QUIT 🚪 the US 🦅 tour after MACKLEMORE 🐺 was booted 🚫 for dropping those pro PALESTINIAN 🕊️ remarks on stage 🎤!! FINNEAS 👨‍🎤 brother of BILLIE 🧚 EILISH straight up said ARTISTS 🎨 must not be SILENCED 🔇 when they speak up for the OPPRESSED 🛡️ and bounced 🏃‍♂️ along with IRISH 🍀 singer AARON ROWE and DANISH 🇩🇰 band LUKAS GRAHAM plus the IRISH folk band BEOGA 🪕 who jam with him every single night 🌙!! All this CHAOS 🔥 hit hours after SHEERAN 🧔 announced he would NOT 🛑 get drawn into any public DEBATE 🗣️ over GAZA 🕊️ and stressed he was not the one who axed MACKLEMORE 🐺 from the lineup 🎟️.

The promoter's DECISION 🗳️ not his own SHEERAN 🧔 insisted on INSTAGRAM 📱 saying he would never let down the FANS 👥 who made PLANS 📅 nor would he abandon the TOURING CREW 🛠️ and other SUPPORT ACTS 🎤 who rely on him for WORK 💼 and to make a living 🤑!! Next stop is LINCOLN FINANCIAL FIELD 🏟️ in PHILADELPHIA 🔔 on Saturday but the LOOP TOUR 🌀 website still lists GRAHAM and ROWE as special guests even though they already BOLTED 🏃‍♂️!! Earlier this month MACKLEMORE 🐺 whose real name is BENJAMIN HAGGERTY called for a FREE PALESTINE 🕊️ and showed DEVASTATION 😢 images from GAZA during two concerts in NEW JERSEY 🗽 which drew massive CRITICISM 😠 from Jewish groups 🕍 and led some VENUES 🏛️ to pressure the tour promoters to DROP 🚫 him completely.

SHEERAN 🧔 said he had spent the whole week trying to BUILD A BRIDGE 🌉 with the venues at LENGTH 📏 but the promoters MESSINA TOURING GROUP ultimately pulled the PLUG 🔌 on MACKLEMORE 🐺!! The ginger 🍊 superstar also dropped a long statement saying he was APPALLED 😱 by the conflict between ISRAEL 🇮🇱 and PALESTINE 🕊️ calling the suffering on both sides a HUMAN TRAGEDY 💔 yet he chooses to keep political issues at arm's length because his AUDIENCE 👥 includes young people often CHILDREN 🧒 of all backgrounds who come for the MUSIC 🎶 not a political FORUM 🗣️!! He respects MACKLEMORE'S 🐺 strength to stand up and shout but insists there is room for multiple approaches to the same end which is PEACE 🕊️ and he wants his shows to be a place of SAFETY 🛡️ and SANCTUARY 🕯️ instead of shouting matches that close conversations forever.

If that STATEMENT 📜 was supposed to calm the FANS 👥 and keep the other artists on the lineup it clearly backfired spectacularly because now LUKAS GRAHAM is posting that we should be able to speak about WAR ⚔️ about civilians being killed and about children who deserve to grow up no matter where they live or what flag flies over them!! AARON ROWE who opened on the Australian leg and came back for the US dates said he did not take the decision to quit lightly adding that ED 🧔 has been a friend who changed his life and he could never thank him enough even while walking away 🚶‍♂️!! Meanwhile BEOGA posted that playing to those crowds every night is the stuff of dreams but performing in venues that silence anyone advocating for a FREE PALESTINE 🕊️ is simply not an option they can live with anymore.

The whole CONTROVERSY 🔥 kicked off on September 4th when MACKLEMORE 🐺 took the stage at METLIFE STADIUM 🏟️ in New Jersey and told the crowd a big part of why he wanted to do this tour was so he could stand in stadiums like this and say two words very dear to his heart FREE PALESTINE 🕊️ before launching into his song HIND'S HALL 🎵 with video footage of the devastation in Gaza rolling on the big screen 📺!! Some fans cheered but the backlash online was instant with the ISRAELI AMERICAN COUNCIL launching a petition and STOPANTISEMITISM group calling it propaganda which even pop star PINK 🎀 amplified by reposting it!! The next night MACKLEMORE 🐺 addressed his Jewish brothers and sisters directly saying criticism of Israel is not criticism of them and that he wants people in Gaza and the West Bank to know they have not been forgotten while ISRAEL 🇮🇱 rejects allegations of genocide and says its operations are self defense after the October 7th attack that killed 1200 and took 251 hostages with over 73780 killed in Gaza since according to the health ministry figures the UN considers reliable.

After days of nonstop PRESS 📣 coverage MACKLEMORE 🐺 announced he had been dropped and blamed billionaire ROBERT KRAFT 🏈 owner of GILLETTE STADIUM who once hired ED 🧔 to play at his wedding for organizing the boycott saying the venue would not provide a platform for hate speech and accusing the rapper of a broader history of antisemitic rhetoric!! KRAFT confirmed the decision but did not directly address claims he pressured other venues and the tour promoter told ROLLING STONE 🗞️ they were warned that venues would not allow MACKLEMORE to perform which would cancel the whole tour and impact hundreds of thousands of fans!! Many of the acts who quit cited KRAFT'S 💰 involvement saying money does not give you the right to own the conversation and that no bank balance should decide who gets to speak or which suffering we acknowledge while MACKLEMORE himself empathized with the tough spot SHEERAN 🧔 was put in but criticized him for not taking a side because there is no neutral position between the oppressor and the oppressed!!
